title: Easy Invisible Item frames
description: The easiest possible way to craft invisible item frames
body:
![Easy Invisible Item Frames Banner Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b558ff454beda7831100e0d619df458b40f36bb6.png)

Adds the easiest possible way to craft invisible item frames and invisible glow item frames.

Thanks to this datapack, you and non-op players on your server will be able to directly access invisible object frames, without commands.

Both recipes have also been added to the recipe/knowledge book.

_Invisible frames lose their invisibility when broken. Place them back in a crafting grid to make them invisible again._
